verdict.rationale: Column documents rail-specific depth for wires: it receives full raw data for all wires and exposes the raw domestic wire message via the get wire transfer endpoint. It also offers a unified cross-rail transfers query endpoint and a bank_account_transaction report in CSV/JSON/Parquet, which supports building on transaction data but does not prove the data is rich. missing for 10: documented counterparty detail fields, rail-specific metadata beyond wires (ACH/RTP/FedNow/checks), explicit stable transaction identifiers, enrichment (e.g., normalized descriptions or categorization), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
